description: This line plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across various categorical variables under the conditions "SST-2, clean-label, poison_rate: 5% (2.6% of total)". The x-axis displays categorical values without an overarching label, featuring the sequential tick labels "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", "stunning", and "beautifully". The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.9 with tick mark intervals of 0.1. The plot contains three solid lines. The first, identified by a grey rectangle in the legend, is a green line with dot markers; it begins at its lowest point of approximately 0.20 at "bb", fluctuates with a peak of 0.74 at "mb" and a drop to 0.41 at "cf", then trends upward to reach its highest point of 0.92 at "stunning" before ending at 0.88 at "beautifully". The second line, labeled "random", is an orange line with 'x' markers that starts at 0.54 at "bb", drops to a minimum of 0.19 at "cf", and then generally increases, despite a minor dip to 0.64 at "wonderful", to finish at its peak of 0.90 at "beautifully". The third line, labeled "end", is a purple line with circle markers starting at 0.51 at "bb"; it exhibits significant volatility, including a sharp rise to 0.83 at "cf", a peak of 0.92 at "wonderful", and a subsequent drop to 0.70 at "brilliant", ultimately concluding at 0.85 at "beautifully".
